# Contributing

Create a focused branch and pull request for every change. Reference specification sections and decision IDs, describe failure and rollback behavior, add tests, and update `CHANGELOG.md`.

Before requesting review, run formatting, Clippy, workspace tests, schema validation, and Compose validation. Never bypass a required check or merge unresolved security, risk, accounting, or compatibility concerns.

Commit messages use an imperative subject and explain why when the change is not obvious. Generated files identify their generator and source revision. Pull requests remain small enough to review against one traceability objective.
